title: Thin subbases of Piatetski-Shapiro sequences
summary: For a non-integral real number $c>1$, let $\mathbb{N}_{(c)}:=\{\lfloor n^c\rfloor ~|~ n\in\mathbb{N}\}$. We show that $\mathbb{N}_{(c)}$ contains thin subbases of every order $h\geq 5$ when $1 2$. In fact, for every regularly varying function $F$ such that \[ \frac{F(x)}{\log x}\to\infty\quad\text{ and } \quad F(x)\leq (1+o(1))\frac{Γ(1+1/c)^h}{Γ(h/c)} x^{h/c-1}, \] there exists $A\subseteq\mathbb{N}_{(c)}$ with $r_{A,h}(n)\sim F(n)$. We also establish analogous results for $k$-th powers of Piatetski-Shapiro numbers and Piatetski-Shapiro primes for small $c$.
